name: CyScenarioBench
intro: CyScenarioBench 是 Irregular 构建的私有场景式网络安全评测框架，它从真实事件抽象攻击树，在全新高保真环境中衡量模型的任务、路径和完整战役级编排能力。
build_method: 真实事件分析, 攻击树建模, 全新高保真仿真环境
metric: 任务/路径/战役成功率, 分支决策, 约束遵循, 推理漂移
eval_feature: 三级嵌套评测, 长程编排, 状态恢复, 抗污染私有集
build_method_en: Real-incident Analysis, Attack-tree Modeling, Fresh High-fidelity Simulations
eval_feature_en: Three Nested Levels, Long-horizon Orchestration, State Recovery, Private Anti-contamination Set
intro_en: CyScenarioBench is Irregular's private scenario-based cybersecurity framework. It abstracts attack trees from real incidents and measures task-, path-, and campaign-level orchestration in fresh high-fidelity environments.
metric_en: Task/Path/Campaign Success, Branching Decisions, Constraint Adherence, Reasoning Drift
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Irregular's official CyScenarioBench working draft dated 2025-12-05, especially Sections 3-4. No arXiv paper or public dataset is claimed. The flow follows the disclosed methodology: analyze real incidents; extract decisions, constraints, and states; formalize attack trees; create fresh unseen containerized environments with websites, personas, voice modules, and defenses; keep the set private; and score models at task, path, and campaign levels while recording branching, drift, dead ends, troubleshooting, and impossible state transitions.
